chunks: If they turn away, tell them: 'I have warned you all alike. I do not know if what has been promised you is near or far away.'
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the timing of the promised warning when people turn away?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Prophet's role as a clear deliverer of the message without imposing belief, highlighting the principle of 'equal footing' in conveying divine warnings. The uncertainty regarding the timing of the promised event reflects the concept of *Taqdir* (divine decree) known only to Allah, encouraging believers to remain vigilant regardless of when the event occurs.
